body:
I've noticed that I wasn't running the newest Version of Angular and the service-worker. So I did a quick update and the problem still exists.

On a bit of a closer look at the source it seems to be a problem with the ```servie-worker/worker/src/driver.ts```

It's, like i was guessing earlier, missing the ```badge``` option.

https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/1fac5f4eb16204d677bba4206a643239274523c6/packages/service-worker/worker/src/driver.ts#L33-L36

Adding Badge and compiling again seems to make it work just fine.

```
 const NOTIFICATION_OPTION_NAMES = [ 
   'actions', 'badge', 'body', 'dir', 'icon', 'lang', 'renotify', 'requireInteraction', 'tag', 'vibrate', 
   'data' 
 ]; 
```

Sounds reasonable :smiley: Thx for investigating, @HiveSolution 👍
Would you be up to submitting a PR with the fix?

##
I was going through the [ServiceWorkerRegistration#showNotification()][1] docs on MDN and we also seem to be ignoring the `image` property.

Since this is experimental technology, I expect the options properties will likely change in the future. Why not just pass through the [data.notification][2] object as is, @alxhub?

[1]: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/ServiceWorkerRegistration/showNotification
[2]: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/1fac5f4eb16204d677bba4206a643239274523c6/packages/service-worker/worker/src/driver.ts#L278

issue.title: fix(service-worker): add badge to NOTIFICATION_OPTION_NAMES (#23196)
